x: We actually started two full teams and a depleted third and our "A" Team of James, Hall, Checkley and Newson were 3rd to Highgate with 38 points.
Our other lads had been going well and at 5 miles Newson was 13th, Demmon (later disqualified) 16th and Ted Smith 31st, with the remainder of the lads moving up well.

After some early dashes to the front, a group, including Checkley and Newson, settled down in the lead. George Checkley walked really well to win in 40m.12s. with Bob Newson second, Syd James (whom we are pleased to see out again) third and Eric Froude, still improving, fourth.
Ted Smith was our first man home in (10th) followed by McMullen, Checkley and Newson, 12th, 15th and 16th. We thus finished 2nd in the Scratch Race despite not having our 2 Olympic men.
Ted Smith,showing his true form,was 4th,Syd James 12th, Checkley 5th.McMullen 7th and Newson 13th.After this we can hope to regain the Berman Cup in our own Open on Nov24th.
